claims: In the 2025-2026 NBA season, the Los Angeles Lakers and Houston Rockets are top-4 Western Conference teams.
Houston Rockets defeated the Los Angeles Lakers 119-96 on December 25, 2025.
Los Angeles Lakers defeated Houston Rockets 140-109 on April 13, 2025.
On March 16-17, 2026, the Houston Rockets (41-25) and Los Angeles Lakers (42-25) face off in a back-to-back.
On March 16-17, 2026, the Houston Rockets and Los Angeles Lakers are separated by 0.5 games for the No. 3/4 seed in the Western Conference.
As of March 2026, the Los Angeles Lakers are led by Luka Doncic and LeBron James.
As of March 2026, the Houston Rockets are led by Amen Thompson and Alperen Sengun.
